text:
The 2021 tree-cover loss was detected by the Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change dataset (version GFC-2025-v1.13). It shows 81.3 ha of loss in 2021, which is 2.23% of the asset's 3,643.5 ha.

Other datasets supported the finding but did not detect the loss:
- **JRC GFC2020 V4:** 98% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020, so it agrees with the baseline.
- **MGAP 2021 forest map:** Of the event area, 68.1 ha was planted forest (Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda), 13.2 ha was outside mapped forest, and 0 ha was native forest.

The event also meets the corroboration rule, since later years of the series (through 2025) were observed and JRC agreement is well above 50%. A further 37.3 ha of 2021 loss was in patches under 0.5 ha and was not counted as an event.
